WITH order_spend AS (
    -- Sum all payment rows once per order, including split payments.
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS spend
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
), customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           -- Missing payments leave spend unknown, not zero.
           CASE WHEN COUNT(p.spend) = COUNT(*)
                THEN ROUND(SUM(p.spend), 2)
           END AS total_spend
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_spend AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
), recency AS (
    -- Recency is elapsed days from the customer's latest delivered-order purchase
    -- to the latest delivered-order purchase in the dataset. Lower is more recent.
    SELECT *,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(latest_purchase) OVER ())
               - JULIANDAY(latest_purchase) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals
), percentiles AS (
    -- Rank each measure best to worst. Tied values share the cumulative percentile
    -- at the end of their tie group. Unknown spend receives no monetary percentile.
    SELECT *,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days) AS r_pct,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS f_pct,
           CASE WHEN total_spend IS NOT NULL THEN
               CUME_DIST() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY (total_spend IS NULL) ORDER BY total_spend DESC
               )
           END AS m_pct
    FROM recency
), scores AS (
    -- The percentile bands end at 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100%.
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN r_pct <= 0.2 THEN 1 WHEN r_pct <= 0.4 THEN 2
                WHEN r_pct <= 0.6 THEN 3 WHEN r_pct <= 0.8 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS r_score,
           CASE WHEN f_pct <= 0.2 THEN 1 WHEN f_pct <= 0.4 THEN 2
                WHEN f_pct <= 0.6 THEN 3 WHEN f_pct <= 0.8 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
           + CASE WHEN m_pct IS NULL THEN NULL
                  WHEN m_pct <= 0.2 THEN 1 WHEN m_pct <= 0.4 THEN 2
                  WHEN m_pct <= 0.6 THEN 3 WHEN m_pct <= 0.8 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS fm_score
    FROM percentiles
), segments AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, total_spend, order_count,
           CASE
               WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
               WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
               WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
               WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
               WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
               WHEN r_score = 3 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
               WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
               WHEN (r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (r_score = 2 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
               WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r_score = 2 AND fm_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r_score = 3 AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scores
)
SELECT customer_unique_id,
       rfm_segment,
       ROUND(total_spend / order_count, 2) AS customer_avg_sales_per_order,
       -- Compare segments using total segment spend divided by total segment orders.
       ROUND(SUM(total_spend) OVER (PARTITION BY rfm_segment)
             / SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY rfm_segment), 2) AS segment_avg_sales_per_order
FROM segments
ORDER BY segment_avg_sales_per_order DESC, rfm_segment, customer_unique_id;

WITH payments_per_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
), customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders,
           AVG(p.order_payment) AS average_payment_per_order,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp))
               - JULIANDAY(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS lifespan_days
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN payments_per_order AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT number_of_orders,
       average_payment_per_order,
       CASE WHEN lifespan_days < 7 THEN 1.0
            ELSE lifespan_days / 7.0
       END AS customer_lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY average_payment_per_order DESC, customer_unique_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH match_totals AS (
    SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN batsman_scored AS s
      ON s.match_id = b.match_id
     AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
     AND s.over_id = b.over_id
     AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
), striker_totals AS (
    SELECT striker, SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM match_totals
    GROUP BY striker
    HAVING MAX(match_runs) > 50
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS average_total_runs
FROM striker_totals;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           o.order_purchase_timestamp,
           c.customer_unique_id,
           c.customer_city,
           c.customer_state
    FROM olist_orders AS o
    JOIN olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
), top_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
    ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC, customer_unique_id
    LIMIT 3
), ranked_locations AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.customer_unique_id
               ORDER BY d.order_purchase_timestamp DESC, d.order_id DESC
           ) AS location_rank
    FROM delivered_orders AS d
    JOIN top_customers AS t ON t.customer_unique_id = d.customer_unique_id
), average_payments AS (
    SELECT d.customer_unique_id,
           AVG(p.payment_value) AS average_payment_value
    FROM ranked_locations AS d
    JOIN olist_order_payments AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT t.customer_unique_id,
       p.average_payment_value,
       l.customer_city,
       l.customer_state
FROM top_customers AS t
JOIN ranked_locations AS l
  ON l.customer_unique_id = t.customer_unique_id AND l.location_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN average_payments AS p ON p.customer_unique_id = t.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY t.delivered_order_count DESC, t.customer_unique_id;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    VALUES ('2020-01-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2020-12-01'
), customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM customer_nodes
), monthly_transactions AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           date(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           SUM(CASE txn_type
                   WHEN 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                   WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01' AND txn_date < '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id, date(txn_date, 'start of month')
), customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, c.customer_id, COALESCE(t.balance, 0) AS balance
    FROM months AS m
    CROSS JOIN customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN monthly_transactions AS t
        ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id AND t.month_start = m.month_start
), monthly_summary AS (
    SELECT month_start,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_customers,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM customer_month_balances
    GROUP BY month_start
), ranked_months AS (
    SELECT month_start, avg_balance,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customers DESC) AS highest_rank,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customers ASC) AS lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_summary
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', h.month_start) AS highest_count_month,
       h.avg_balance AS highest_count_avg_balance,
       strftime('%Y-%m', l.month_start) AS lowest_count_month,
       l.avg_balance AS lowest_count_avg_balance,
       h.avg_balance - l.avg_balance AS avg_balance_difference
FROM ranked_months AS h
CROSS JOIN ranked_months AS l
WHERE h.highest_rank = 1 AND l.lowest_rank = 1
ORDER BY h.month_start, l.month_start;

WITH daily_insertions AS (
    SELECT country_code_2,
           DATE(insert_date) AS insertion_day,
           COUNT(*) AS entry_count,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN capital = 1 THEN 1 END) AS capital_entry_count
    FROM cities
    WHERE DATE(insert_date) >= '2022-01-01'
      AND DATE(insert_date) < '2022-02-01'
    GROUP BY country_code_2, DATE(insert_date)
), numbered_days AS (
    SELECT *,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2) AS january_insertion_days,
           JULIANDAY(insertion_day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insertion_day
           ) AS streak_key
    FROM daily_insertions
), ranked_streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2,
           MIN(insertion_day) AS period_start,
           MAX(insertion_day) AS period_end,
           1.0 * SUM(capital_entry_count) / SUM(entry_count) AS capital_proportion,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS streak_rank
    FROM numbered_days
    WHERE january_insertion_days = 9
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_key
)
SELECT c.country_name,
       s.period_start,
       s.period_end,
       s.capital_proportion
FROM ranked_streaks AS s
JOIN cities_countries AS c ON c.country_code_2 = s.country_code_2
WHERE s.streak_rank = 1
ORDER BY c.country_name, s.period_start;

WITH orders AS (
    SELECT o.rowid AS row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, n.pizza_name,
           CASE WHEN n.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS pizza_id,
           o.order_time, o.exclusions, o.extras
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders AS o
    JOIN pizza_names AS n ON n.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
), ingredient_occurrences AS (
    SELECT o.row_id, CAST(s.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN pizza_recipes AS r ON r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || r.toppings || ']') AS s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM json_each('[' || COALESCE(o.exclusions, '') || ']') AS x
        WHERE CAST(x.value AS INTEGER) = CAST(s.value AS INTEGER)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.row_id, CAST(e.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM orders AS o
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || COALESCE(o.extras, '') || ']') AS e
), ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT row_id, topping_id, COUNT(*) AS quantity
    FROM ingredient_occurrences
    GROUP BY row_id, topping_id
)
SELECT o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_name,
       o.pizza_name || ': ' || COALESCE(
           GROUP_CONCAT(
               CASE WHEN c.quantity > 1 THEN '2x' || t.topping_name
                    ELSE t.topping_name END,
               ', ' ORDER BY (c.quantity > 1) DESC, t.topping_name COLLATE NOCASE
           ), ''
       ) AS ingredients
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN ingredient_counts AS c ON c.row_id = o.row_id
LEFT JOIN pizza_toppings AS t ON t.topping_id = c.topping_id
GROUP BY o.row_id, o.order_id, o.pizza_name, o.order_time, o.customer_id
ORDER BY o.row_id ASC;

           COALESCE(SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_details AS od ON od.orderid = o.orderid
    WHERE o.orderdate >= '1998-01-01'
      AND o.orderdate < '1999-01-01'
      AND o.customerid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.customerid
)
SELECT t.groupname AS spending_group,
       COUNT(s.customerid) AS customer_count,
       100.0 * COUNT(s.customerid) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_spending) AS customer_percentage
FROM customergroupthreshold AS t
LEFT JOIN customer_spending AS s
    ON s.total_spent BETWEEN t.rangebottom AND t.rangetop
GROUP BY t.groupname, t.rangebottom, t.rangetop
ORDER BY t.rangebottom;

    LEFT JOIN Person AS p ON p.PID = TRIM(c.PID)

GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY year;

WITH salary_distances AS (
    SELECT FacRank, FacFirstName, FacLastName, FacSalary,
           ABS(FacSalary * COUNT(FacSalary) OVER (PARTITION BY FacRank)
               - SUM(FacSalary) OVER (PARTITION BY FacRank)) AS scaled_distance
    FROM university_faculty
), closest AS (
    SELECT FacRank, FacFirstName, FacLastName, FacSalary, scaled_distance,
           MIN(scaled_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY FacRank) AS min_scaled_distance
    FROM salary_distances
)
SELECT FacRank, FacFirstName, FacLastName, FacSalary
FROM closest
WHERE scaled_distance = min_scaled_distance
ORDER BY FacRank, FacLastName, FacFirstName, FacSalary;

WITH cast_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT film_id, actor_id
    FROM film_actor
),
cast_sizes AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count
    FROM cast_members
    GROUP BY film_id
),
film_revenues AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM payment AS p
    JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
ranked_films AS (
    SELECT cm.actor_id,
           cm.film_id,
           COALESCE(fr.total_revenue, 0.0) / cs.actor_count AS average_revenue_per_actor,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY cm.actor_id
               ORDER BY COALESCE(fr.total_revenue, 0.0) DESC, cm.film_id
           ) AS film_rank
    FROM cast_members AS cm
    JOIN cast_sizes AS cs ON cs.film_id = cm.film_id
    LEFT JOIN film_revenues AS fr ON fr.film_id = cm.film_id
)
SELECT a.actor_id,
       a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_name,
       f.title AS film_title,
       rf.average_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films AS rf
JOIN actor AS a ON a.actor_id = rf.actor_id
JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = rf.film_id
WHERE rf.film_rank <= 3
ORDER BY a.actor_id, rf.film_rank;

WITH season_results AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id, res.points
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
), driver_totals AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM season_results
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
), constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM season_results
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
), driver_maxima AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS top_driver_points
    FROM driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
), constructor_maxima AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS top_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT d.year
FROM driver_maxima AS d
JOIN constructor_maxima AS c ON c.year = d.year
ORDER BY d.top_driver_points + c.top_constructor_points ASC, d.year ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH point_results AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM results
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM sprint_results
),
driver_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, p.driver_id, p.constructor_id, SUM(p.points) AS points
    FROM point_results AS p
    JOIN races AS r ON r.race_id = p.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, p.driver_id, p.constructor_id
),
driver_season_points AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM driver_constructor_points
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING SUM(points) > 0
),
season_minimums AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) AS min_points
    FROM driver_season_points
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor, COUNT(DISTINCT d.year) AS season_count
FROM driver_season_points AS d
JOIN season_minimums AS m ON m.year = d.year AND m.min_points = d.total_points
JOIN driver_constructor_points AS p ON p.year = d.year AND p.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = p.constructor_id
WHERE p.points > 0
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, c.name ASC, c.constructor_id ASC
LIMIT 5;
